task: Open /home/user/Documents/portrait_mask.kra in Krita. The file contains a single paint layer named 'Portrait'. Add a Transparency Mask as a child of the 'Portrait' layer and name the mask exactly 'FadeEdges'. Do not rename or delete the Portrait layer. Save the file in place (Ctrl+S) so the result is written back to /home/user/Documents/portrait_mask.kra.

verification.description: FadeEdges mask is a child of Portrait

cli_feasibility.translation: Add transparency mask 'FadeEdges' to Portrait layer
